name: patch-writer
description: Write Morphe patches — fingerprints, patch logic, and constants for feature adaptation and customization

agentSpawn.command: PATCHES_DIR="${MORPHE_PATCHES_DIR:-morphe-patches}"; echo '--- Existing Patches ---' && find "${PATCHES_DIR}/patches/src/main/kotlin" -mindepth 4 -maxdepth 4 -type d 2>/dev/null | xargs -I{} basename {} || echo 'No patches yet'

postToolUse.command: PATCHES_DIR="${MORPHE_PATCHES_DIR:-morphe-patches}"; if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "${PATCHES_DIR}/patches/src.*\.kt"; then cd "${PATCHES_DIR}" && ./gradlew buildAndroid 2>&1 | tail -5; fi

welcomeMessage: Patch Writer ready. Provide analysis findings from notes, verified smali signatures, and target app package details to generate Fingerprints.kt, Patch.kt, and Constants.kt. Writing patch .kt files triggers the configured local Gradle build hook.
